description: A multi-site security facility has suffered a breach. The overnight security operations team has been disbanded and cameras have been left unconfigured. Your job is to restore full surveillance capability for incident response. Specifically: (1) Identify which cameras currently have no recording schedule and enable continuous 24/7 recording on ALL cameras that lack it — do not assume you know which ones without checking. (2) The 'Night Watch Commander' role that was responsible for monitoring overnight has an outdated user account: locate the user named 'security.operator', update their full name to 'Night Watch Commander' and their email to 'nightwatch@facility-security.com'. (3) Create a new user account with login 'incident.cmdr', full name 'Incident Commander', email 'incident@facility-security.com', and role 'Viewer'. (4) Create a layout named 'Incident Command Center' that contains all three cameras (Parking Lot Camera, Entrance Camera, and Server Room Camera). The facility runs Nx Witness VMS at https://localhost:7001. Login: admin / Admin1234!
